ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: The visible surface is dominated by low-intensity (black) pixels, with high-intensity (white/grey) pixels comprising approximately 5-10% of the surface area localized at the distal margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black region occupies the central 90% of the visible fluke; distinct white and grey mottled patches are mapped to the distal edges and tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 75 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of approximately 1:2.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes varying between 2-8 pixels along the entire trailing edge boundary, isolated against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edges from the notch transitioning to convex curvature at the outer distal margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast, roughly circular clusters (barnacle colonies) are localized at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization present on the distal tips of both lobes, creating a textured, irregular structural boundary.
